answer: Require each identity to complete 200 useful labeling tasks each epoch, with 20 hidden gold items mixed in as a signal of real work. The gold items are indistinguishable, so a script or copied answer scores near chance, while a careful worker scores at least 90%. Below 90%, the identity's 50-token bond burns and its progress resets. One operator cannot echo the same answers across accounts: each account faces different gold items, so 100 fakes need 20,000 accurate labels, not one copied set. A knoll of shared answers collapses when gold accuracy is checked.
